components.text: References show plants like yours make it work. What you save is worked from your own bills, load curve and roof.

footnote: Source: Laibao Hi-Tech (2024-10-30), Zhonglou District, Changzhou (2025-04-11), Yangtse Evening Post (2026-07-01), EGing PV (2025-04-29)
notes: All five references come from public records. None is our project. They show what plants like yours have done and what figures they have published. Laibao Hi-Tech's plant in Guangming, Shenzhen, runs a 2.541 MWp array under a 20-year EMC, with forecast savings of about RMB 629,000 a year and forecast output of 2.956 million kWh. Changzhou's Zhonglou district reported two parks: Jinruida's first phase, about 1.6 MW, makes 1.467 million kWh a year and saves about RMB 360,000. That is about 917 hours per MW, below Jiangsu's official parameter, which is a reminder that each roof's real output has to be measured. Zhigu Works pairs solar with storage. The Taijing plants in Gaoyou, Yangzhou, are a large solar and storage microgrid with an expected 50 million kWh of green power a year, in figures given by the power supply company. The most useful line is EGing PV's four Jiangsu sites, whose data an accounting firm audited: 991 to 1,098 hours a year, with 77.7% to 91.0% of the power used on site. References only show that it can be done. What you would save still depends on your own documents.
